description: Land Acquisition - Supplement Nos. 08, 09 and 10 of F.T.P. No. 13 of Pulanchiya, Galgamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels and servitudes for public purpose (road development), including descriptions of land lots, extents, claimants, and compensation procedures. This fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it focuses entirely on land acquisition and property matters.
